items.description_zh: DSH 插件：跨会话图钉笔记板——在 token 预算内将置顶笔记带入每个会话的系统提示词（/pin /unpin /pins, pin_add）。

items.name: dsh-rerun-turn
items.description: Infix rerun for DeepSeek Harness: re-run any earlier turn in place - the reply is regenerated from the same prompt while every later turn survives, so subsequent calls read A B C1 D E F G. Official seams only; the append-only session log is never rewritten.
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness  infix 重跑：原地重跑任意早期回合——在同一提示词下重新生成回复，后续所有回合保留，因此后续调用呈现 A B C1 D E F G 格式。仅限官方接口；追加式会话日志永不重写。

items.name: dsh-image-gen
items.description: DeepSeek Harness 生图插件：侧边栏绘画页与图库，对话中生图和改图，可自定义服务商端点与代理。

items.name: dsh-model-aliases
items.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供持久化模型别名：将提供商、模型与推理等级绑定为易记名称，并通过输入框旁的单一选择器快速切换。

items.name: dsh-notify-ar
items.description: Arabic-first actionable Windows notifications for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): toast buttons that approve permissions, continue, or stop the agent — without opening the app. Bilingual ar/en with RTL.
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 阿拉伯语优先的可操作 Windows 通知：Toast 按钮用于批准权限、继续或停止智能体——无需打开应用。支持 ar/en 双语及 RTL。

items.name: dsh-agent-swarm
items.description: DeepSeek Harness 中文多智能体插件「百工」：天枢统筹 12 位专家，证据门禁、多层模型路由与回退、内嵌 Jev 判断工具

items.name: dsh-typewriter-blip
items.description: Speech blips while the assistant's answer streams - audible even when the window is in the background; swappable voices, or shape your own.
items.description_zh: 智能体回答流式传输期间的语音提示音——即使窗口在后台也可听见；支持可替换语音或自定义语音。

items.name: dsh-zhuang-fangyi

items.name: dsh-gov-workbench

items.name: dsh-auth-remote

items.name: dsh-approval-chime

items.name: dsh-connect-zcode

items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话树的离线 Pi 风格 HTML 导出

items.name: dsh-local-share
items.description: Select and locally share one or more DeepSeek Harness conversation turns as Markdown, self-contained HTML, or a long PNG, with privacy-first redaction and no uploads
items.description_zh: 选择并本地分享一个或多个 DeepSeek Harness 对话回合，支持 Markdown、自包含 HTML 或长 PNG 格式，采用隐私优先的脱敏处理，无任何上传操作。

items.name: @yokira404/dsh-thinking-highlight
items.description: Chain-of-thought keyword counting and highlighting: per-word count chips with a click-to-suppress switch, per-word colour, text colour and text size, whole-word matching, and a dedicated settings section
items.description_zh: 思维链关键词计数与高亮：每个词独立的计数标签，支持点击切换隐藏、每个词的颜色、文字颜色和字号、整词匹配，以及专用设置区域。

items.name: dsh-newbe-response-window
items.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web plugin: per-turn response window. Each turn's tool calls collapse into ONE always-expanded bounded slide (configurable N-line window, inner scroll, nothing hidden), and long assistant markdown gets a bounded scroll window too —
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web 插件：每轮响应窗口。每轮的 tool calls 折叠为一条始终展开的固定高度幻灯片（可配置 N 行窗口，内部可滚动，内容无隐藏），长助手 markdown 同样提供固定高度滚动窗口。

items.name: dsh-insight-dock
items.description: Insight dock for the DSH Web GUI: lets an agent park a short, strictly-bounded side observation while it works, shows it above the composer, and lets the user ask to hear it later — with a context anchor that survives context compaction.
items.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 洞察停靠栏：让智能体在工作时停靠一条严格有界的简短侧边观察，显示在编辑器上方，并允许用户稍后听取——附带在上下文压缩后仍能保留的上下文锚点。

items.name: dsh-terminal-panel
items.description: In-page terminal panel for DeepSeek Harness: real PTY terminals opened from the sidebar, with tabs, rename and live replay. DSH 网页内的终端面板插件。

items.name: dsh-diorama
items.description: DSH Diorama — character skins with an editable decoration board for DeepSeek Harness: 雪乃·暖阳日常 (Yukino warm daily) and 隐秘年代志 (occult editorial), each with dual character sprites + sticker sheets. Dropdown skin switcher, drag/resize/rotate coordinate editor

items.name: dsh-screen-automation
items.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that bridges the local 'Screen Automation Helper' desktop platform (Windows/macOS) into the Agent tool system. Exposes status, capabilities, workflow list/run/stop, run management, screen capture, local recognition primitives
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件，将本地 'Screen Automation Helper' 桌面平台（Windows/macOS）桥接至 Agent 工具系统。暴露状态、能力、工作流列表/运行/停止、运行管理、屏幕截图、本地识别原语

items.name: dsh-cursor-theme
items.description: Customize the PC mouse cursor for every UI state inside DeepSeek Harness. 在 DSH 里自定义鼠标各种状态的图案。

items.name: dsh-ocr-bridge
items.description: Paste images into DeepSeek Harness chat and have them read by a free local backend (macOS Vision / Tesseract) before the text-only DeepSeek model answers
items.description_zh: 将图片粘贴到 DeepSeek Harness 聊天中，由免费本地后端（macOS Vision / Tesseract）在纯文本 DeepSeek 模型回答之前先读取图像

items.name: dsh-research-writing
items.description: Research writing bundle for DeepSeek Harness: literature search/citation (dsh-lit-search) + LaTeX/BibTeX guard (dsh-latex-guard) in one install.
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 研究写作 bundle：文献搜索/引用（dsh-lit-search）+ LaTeX/BibTeX 守卫（dsh-latex-guard），一次安装完成。

items.name: dsh-session-notify
items.description: DSH web plugin: desktop notification, chime, and title flash when a session stops — finished output or waiting for human input. Click a notification to jump to that session.
items.description_zh: DSH Web 插件：会话结束（完成输出或等待人工输入）时触发桌面通知、提示音和标题闪烁，点击通知可跳转到对应会话。

items.name: dsh-theme-cutout-clash
items.description: EN: Selectable neo-brutalist/pop-art themes for DeepSeek Harness Web with calm reading surfaces. 0.5.10 fixes the queued-message banner and the composer attachment button in every variant. ZH: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web、兼顾安静阅读表面的新粗野主义与波普艺术主题。0.5.10 修复全部变体的排队

items.name: dsh-session-reattach
items.description: 会话归位：把游离（未分组）会话按 canonical cwd 重新归属到匹配的工作区，只修 workspace 归属记录，不动会话文件。

items.name: dsh-deliberation
items.description: Primary-controlled deliberation and opt-in masked review for DeepSeek Harness
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的主控深思与可选屏蔽审查功能

items.name: dsh-antigravity-oauth
items.description: Isolated Gemini Cloud Code Assist OAuth for DeepSeek Harness. Independent store. Gemini flash only.
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 隔离的 Gemini Cloud Code Assist OAuth。独立存储。仅支持 Gemini flash。

items.name: @dfy-plugins/dsh-turn-guard
items.description: 为单轮任务提供收敛提醒、重复调用检测和可配置的硬停止预算。

items.name: @starpivot/dsh-better-sidebar
items.description: StarPivot fork of dsh-better-sidebar: a VS Code-like right sidebar with explorer, editor, terminal, Git, and browser. Collapse controls stay in the panel instead of under the desktop title bar.
items.description_zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的 StarPivot 分支：类 VS Code 的右侧边栏，包含资源管理器、编辑器、终端、Git 和浏览器。折叠控件保留在面板内，而非置于桌面标题栏下。

items.name: @dfy-plugins/dsh-archive-manager
items.description: 归档对话管理：按项目查看、取消归档或永久删除已归档的对话。

items.name: dsh-harness-audit
items.description: Audit an agent harness against the harness-evaluation criteria, with machine-enforced evidence validation.
items.description_zh: 根据 harness-evaluation 标准审计 Agent Harness，并通过机器强制执行证据验证。

items.name: dsh-fx-marquee
items.description: Live FX and market ticker above the composer, with trend charts, per-market session status and a frozen-rate currency calculator. 输入框上方的实时汇率跑马灯，含走势图、交易时段与汇率计算器。

items.name: dsh-memory-triage
items.description: DeepSeek Harness 记忆分诊插件：自动判断记忆保留/归档，并自动路由到项目桶或总体桶（规则优先 + LLM 兜底）

items.name: @qing3a/dsh-tray
items.description: Windows 系统托盘插件：托盘图标 + 菜单（打开界面/状态/退出）+ 气泡通知，基于 trayicon（exe 宿主，无 native 编译）

items.name: @zhengjunyao/dsh-qqmail
items.description: QQ Mail (and any IMAP/SMTP mailbox) for DeepSeek Harness: registers qqmail_* agent tools that list, search, read, send, reply to, flag and download mail through IMAP/SMTP with a QQ Mail authorization code (no OAuth, no 2FA redirect), plus a `qqmail` CLI a
items.description_zh: QQ 邮箱（及任意 IMAP/SMTP 邮箱）用于 DeepSeek Harness：注册 qqmail_* agent 工具，通过 IMAP/SMTP 和 QQ 邮箱授权码（无需 OAuth，无需 2FA 跳转）实现邮件的列出、搜索、阅读、发送、回复、标记和下载，并提供一个 `qqmail` CLI。

items.name: dsh-process-board
items.description: DSH 服务面板：查看由哪个对话（Agent 会话）启动了哪些服务——PEB 环境块读取 DSH_SESSION_ID 归属（含分离进程），三态健康探测 + HTTP 码，支持礼貌停止、日志实时查看与启动参数重放。Host scans agent-started services with session attribution; client renders a fullscreen table panel with tri-state health, graceful stop, live logs

items.name: dsh-npm-runner
items.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: discovers the npm/pnpm/yarn/bun scripts of the current workspace (never descending into node_modules) and runs any of them in the background from a compact control in the composer area or the session header.
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：发现当前工作区的 npm/pnpm/yarn/bun 脚本（永不递归进入 node_modules），并通过 Composer 区域或会话头部的紧凑控件在后台运行任意脚本。

items.name: dsh-tool-accurate-vision
items.description: Model-facing accurate_vision tool: precise image spatial reasoning via a vision model
items.description_zh: 面向模型的 accurate_vision 工具：通过视觉模型进行精确图像空间推理

items.name: dsh-claude-marketplace
items.description: Claude Code compatibility layer for DeepSeek Harness: load .claude skills/commands/agents and install plugins from Claude Code marketplaces as native dsh skills.
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness Claude Code 兼容层：加载 .claude skills/commands/agents，并从 Claude Code 市场安装插件作为原生 dsh 技能。

items.name: dsh-wooden-fish
items.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 模式插件：在页面中央展示木鱼与木锤，点击木鱼敲击并弹出「功德 +1」，同时播报「南无阿弥陀佛」。

items.name: relay-dsh-plugin-monitor-author
items.description: DSH Skill provider for discovering and safely creating Relay Monitor Bundles.
items.description_zh: DSH Skill 提供者：用于发现和安全创建 Relay Monitor 捆绑包。

items.name: @jetecho/dsh-csv-and-image-preview
items.description: Preview images / SVG and CSV tables in the DeepSeek Harness chat, rendered as real browser / elements. Preview-first workflow: show the user the asset, wait for approval, then apply the real change.
items.description_zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 聊天中预览图像/SVG 和 CSV 表格，以真实浏览器 / 元素渲染。预览优先工作流：先向用户展示资产，等待批准后，再应用实际更改

items.name: dsh-ui-scale
items.description: Scale the DeepSeek Harness interface from 50% to 200%
items.description_zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 界面缩放从 50% 到 200%

items.name: dsh-plugin-windows-guard
items.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Windows 环境防坑插件：两个防坑 skill（windows-enc/windows-sys：编码/转义/路径/进程/乱码预防规则）+ 三层主动防护（pwsh 结果乱码检测提示、危险写命令拦截、windows_encode_detect/fix 编码诊断修复工具）。零运行时依赖，零构建。

items.name: dsh-done
items.description: Task completion celebration popup with sound for DeepSeek Harness · 任务完成后弹出庆祝弹窗并播放音效

items.name: @achasoft/dsh-add-assets
items.description: Composer add-assets plate for the DeepSeek Harness Web Client: an options menu on the composer's + button (files, folders, slash commands) and a Claude Code-style draft attachment preview
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness Web Client 的 Composer 添加资产面板：Composer 的 + 按钮上的选项菜单（文件、文件夹、斜杠命令）以及 Claude Code 风格的草稿附件预览

items.name: dsh-contract-check
items.description: Contract check for DeepSeek Harness plugins: statically verifies that registered tools' output.render() returns ContentBlock[], and warns when a session event type falls outside the kernel vocabulary. Warn-only. 契约体检插件（不检测恶意）。

items.name: dsh-notify-zeta
items.description: DeepSeek Harness notification center with interactive Windows question and approval cards
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 通知中心，支持交互式 Windows 问答与审批卡片

items.name: dsh-plugin-lcu
items.description: Drive the desktop and Chrome from DeepSeek Harness using the computer-use runtime inside the ChatGPT desktop application.
items.description_zh: 通过 DeepSeek Harness 使用 ChatGPT 桌面应用内的 computer-use 运行时控制桌面和 Chrome。

items.name: dsh-task-effort
items.description: Auto-adjust model reasoning effort per task: off/low/high/max with task classification, peak-pricing-period capping, countdown notices, and in-turn error escalation
items.description_zh: 按任务自动调整模型推理力度：提供关闭/低/高/最高档位，支持任务分类、峰值定价时段限流、倒计时通知以及轮次内错误升级。

items.name: dsh-desktop-notifier
items.description: DeepSeek Harness Web: raise an OS notification when a task finishes (or needs your input) while the harness page is not focused
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness Web：当任务完成（或需要你的输入）而 Harness 页面未聚焦时，触发操作系统通知

items.name: dsh-qqbot-panel
items.description: Visual web settings panel for the official @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot plugin: manage the QQ Bot AppID/AppSecret, c2c & group access modes/allowlists, cwd and requireMention directly in the DSH web settings page (reads/writes the qqbot profile's cordis.pat
items.description_zh: 官方 @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 插件的可视化网页设置面板：在 DSH 网页设置页面直接管理 QQ Bot AppID/AppSecret、c2c 与群组访问模式/白名单、cwd 及 requireMention（读取并写入 qqbot profile 的 cordis.pat）

items.name: dsh-siliconflow-vision
items.description: DSH 插件：通过硅基流动(SiliconFlow)视觉大模型识别/分析图片，支持本地文件路径、http(s) 图片 URL 与 base64 data URL。含持久化的粘贴识别面板（web 端）。

items.name: dsh-model-picker-plus
items.description: A grouped, searchable replacement for the DSH composer model selector.
items.description_zh: 分组且可搜索的 DSH 编辑器模型选择器替代方案。

items.name: dsh-commandcode-quota
items.description: Command Code balance and quota panel for DeepSeek Harness: a status row under the composer showing balance and the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows.
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Command Code 余额与配额面板：在作曲家下方显示状态行，包含余额以及 5小时、周度和月度窗口。

items.name: dsh-clipbook
items.description: DSH 小夹子：把对话里值得留的话夹起来——一键收藏助手回复，随手翻、随手取、随手导出。

items.name: dsh-mcp-plus
items.description: DSH 增强型 MCP 客户端插件:在设置界面管理多台 MCP 服务器,自动发现并注册工具给 Agent

items.name: @ttmouse/dsh-chat-history
items.description: ChatGPT-style conversation-history rail for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a strip of bars at the transcript's right edge with a hover panel listing every user message, click-to-jump and scroll-synced highlighting.
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的 ChatGPT 风格对话历史侧栏：位于对话记录右侧的条带，悬停时列出所有用户消息，支持点击跳转和滚动同步高亮。

items.name: dsh-plugin-busy-workspace
items.description: Highlights running sessions and pins workspaces with active sessions to the top of the dsh Web GUI sidebar.
items.description_zh: 高亮运行中的会话，并将包含活跃会话的工作区置顶于 dsh Web GUI 侧边栏。

items.name: dsh-fs-deny-policy
items.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a deployment deny list of filesystem roots the model may never touch - fences read, write, search, and shell tool calls at tools/pre-execute
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：部署拒绝列表，限定模型永远不得触碰的文件系统根目录 —— 在 tools/pre-execute 阶段拦截读取、写入、搜索和 shell 工具调用。

items.name: dsh-context-budget
items.description: Keeps a local model's context at a size the GPU handles well: measured prefill speed, hard ceiling, early compaction for DeepSeek Harness
items.description_zh: 将本地模型的上下文大小控制在 GPU 处理舒适的范围内：测量预填充速度、设置硬性上限、提前对 DeepSeek Harness 进行上下文压缩。

items.name: @trujaycc/dsh-ui-easyfold
items.description: Easy-fold plugin for the dsh Web GUI: sticky Think fold row and fold scroll compensation for long expanded content
items.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 的易折叠插件：固定 Think 折叠行，并对长展开内容提供折叠滚动补偿。

items.name: dsh-sensenova-pool
items.description: 商汤日日新（SenseNova）多 Key 轮换池 — 填入多把 Key 即可零配置接入 DeepSeek Harness，遇 429 限流自动切换下一把 Key。

items.name: dsh-model-relay
items.description: Model relay station for DeepSeek Harness (模型中转站): serve any registered DSH LLM provider (e.g. @tnnevol/dsh-codebuddy) over an OpenAI-compatible /v1 API, so other projects can call those models with a standard OpenAI client.

items.name: @leolee9086/dsh-fetch-router
items.description: Route and rewrite the harness's outbound HTTP requests by host and path, with a native right-sidebar monitor.
items.description_zh: 按主机和路径路由及重写 harness 出站 HTTP 请求，并附带原生右侧边栏监控。

items.name: dsh-memory-recall
items.description: Persistent memory for dsh in the style of Hermes Agent: a memory tool that keeps a user profile and the model's own notes, delivered to every chat as a logged context message — at the start, after a change and after compaction — and a session_search tool
items.description_zh: dsh 持久化记忆，风格仿 Hermes Agent：一个记忆工具，维护用户画像和模型自身的笔记，作为日志上下文消息在每次对话开始时、变更发生后及压缩后投递给所有聊天，并提供 session_search 工具。

items.name: dsh-tavily-firecrawl
items.description: Tavily search + Firecrawl fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness (web capability seam, ctx.web), with multi-key rotation
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Tavily 搜索 + Firecrawl 抓取提供商（web 能力接口 ctx.web），支持多密钥轮换

items.name: dsh-web-search-firecrawl
items.description: Firecrawl search provider and multi-account settings for DeepSeek Harness
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Firecrawl 搜索引擎提供商及多账户设置。

items.name: dsh-theme-machine
items.description: Person-of-Interest skin for DeepSeek Harness: THE MACHINE surveillance-HUD theme (dark, cyan-on-black). Token override layer + HUD chrome + live telemetry panel for the dsh web UI.
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Person-of-Interest 皮肤：THE MACHINE 监控 HUD 主题（黑色背景青色）。包含 Token 覆盖层、HUD 装饰组件和 dsh Web UI 的实时遥测面板。

items.name: dsh-local-proxy
items.description: DSH plugin: discover this machine's HTTP proxy (proxy env vars, else the Windows system proxy) and make DSH use it — for the agent's in-process fetches and for every child process it spawns.
items.description_zh: DSH 插件：自动发现本机的 HTTP 代理（优先使用代理环境变量，否则使用 Windows 系统代理）并让 DSH 生效——同时作用于 agent 的进程内请求以及它派生的所有子进程

items.name: dsh-plug-skills
items.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 Skills 管理器：在 设置 → 插件 → Skills 标签页中发现 GitHub 上的 Agent Skills 仓库（SKILL.md 技能包，topic:agent-skills / dsh-skill / claude-skills），查看详情后一键安装 / 移除。技能装入 $DSH_HOME/skills，skill-filesystem 热加载，无需重启。支持 GitHub 代理。

items.name: dsh-thrum
items.description: DeepSeek Harness 输入氛围插件：为输入过程增添氛围。

items.name: @zfgcta/dsh-multi-folder
items.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: secondary working directories for a project. The agent keeps the primary workspace as cwd, gains equal write/exec permissions on configured secondary directories under workspace-write mode, and is notified of configuration changes
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：项目的辅助工作目录。agent 保持主工作区为 cwd，在 workspace-write 模式下对配置的辅助目录拥有同等读写/执行权限，并在配置变更时收到通知。

items.name: dsh-tool-computer
items.description: Computer use plugin for DeepSeek Harness: one plugin composing the computer seam, a Playwright provider, and the computer_* tools
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的电脑操作插件：一个插件整合 computer seam、Playwright 提供商及 computer_* 工具。

items.name: @xiaobanli/dsh-enterprise-compliance
items.description: Enterprise compliance for DeepSeek Harness — SOC2/GDPR automated checks, sensitive-info redaction, and a redacted tool audit trail. · DSH 企业级合规插件：SOC2/GDPR 自动化合规自检、敏感信息拦截与脱敏、操作日志审计追溯。

items.name: dsh-envelope-highlight
items.description: Restore syntax highlighting of read/write tool envelopes inside run_code (PTC / Code Mode) result cards
items.description_zh: 恢复 run_code (PTC / 代码模式) 结果卡片中 read/write 工具信封的语法高亮

items.name: dsh-magpie-connect
items.description: Magpie gateway models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): native dsh-llm adapter plugin with image + responses + thinking levels.
items.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的 Magpie 网关模型：原生 dsh-llm 适配器插件，支持图像、响应和思维层级。

items.name: @uachar/dsh-ui-chime
items.description: DSH 思考结束提示音：每轮对话完成或等待用户答复时在浏览器播放提示音，支持音量调节。

items.name: dsh-copilot-key
items.description: Manage the Windows Copilot-key hook (DshCopilotKey.exe) from inside DeepSeek Harness: status, start/stop/restart, trigger, config.ini editing and logs.
items.description_zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内部管理 Windows Copilot 键钩子（DshCopilotKey.exe）：查看状态、启动/停止/重启、触发操作、编辑 config.ini 及查看日志。

items.name: dsh-open-in-app-base
items.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：Session header 的 "Open In..." 按钮组底座，提供注册契约供同类插件补充目标软件。

items.name: dsh-session-keepwarm
items.description: Keeps the most recently used sessions resident in the browser, so switching back reuses the loaded history instead of re-reading it.
